up: Return a list of compounds reported in the document CHEMBL4420062. For each compound, provide the following columns: the molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), the preferred name (pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4420062'
